description: Append-only time-series log of technology penetration observations, keyed Brand x Technology Category x Vendor x Product x Date. Distinguishes location, operator, system-sales, transaction, and module penetration, and distinguishes brand-level from operator-level observations (one franchisee's rollout count must never be presented as the whole brand's footprint). Never fabricate a figure when only partial evidence exists -- use {low, high} ranges. See system/SCHEMAS.md, 'Technology Lifecycle & Change Events' -> 'technology_penetration.jsonl' for the full record shape. Never edit or delete an existing line; a correction is a new line with a supersedes field pointing at the observation_id it corrects.
